scope: One fresh Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster. Two administrator-labeled namespaces assign train-verify-lock and continuous-learning profiles. Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicies and namespace-selected bindings validate Deployment pod templates on CREATE and UPDATE. Matched missing-profile probes and permitted non-AI Deployments are independently checked in both namespaces. Each valid profile Deployment executes a fixed, inert Python fixture: the train-lock init container writes fixed bytes and a SHA-256 baseline consumed by an integrity monitor; the continuous-learning init container writes one fixed synthetic before/after pair and its drift monitor measures the difference. No model, external service, network service, host port, or real authorization system is used.
